props.animation_script:
// =============================================================================

// Hellhound - Pounce (fast dash melee, speed emphasis). Bespoke.

// The hound blurs forward onto the target leaving a streaked afterimage trail,

// slams with an impact flash + brief shake, then recoils home. doneHook fires

// on the slam.

// =============================================================================

(async () => {

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.hellhound.pounce";

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][Pounce]";

const CFG = {

lungeFrac: 0.92, lungeMs: 130, returnMs: 220, recoilHoldMs: 60,

ghostEveryMs: 16, ghostFadeMs: 220, ghostAlpha: 0.5,

flashColor: 0xFFE0A0, flashSize: 0.18,

particleColor: 0xFFC060, particleCount: 12, particleSize: 0.02, particleSpread: 0.13, particleMs: 460,

shakePx: 0.016, shakeMs: 300, endPadMs: 120, totalTimeoutMs: 7000,

};

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) { try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; } }

function resolveSource() {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

return out;

}

const sourceToken = resolveSource();

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

const doneHook = "oni.anim." + ANIM_KEY + "." + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

function onceHook(name, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(name, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(name, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

Hooks.on(name, h);

});

}

function emitLocal(name, data) { try { Hooks.callAll(name, data); } catch (_) {} }

const scriptSource = String.raw`

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targetTokens = ctx.targetTokens || [];

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg;

const stage = canvas.stage;

stage.sortableChildren = true;

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const W = canvas.app.renderer.screen.width;

const H = canvas.app.renderer.screen.height;

const WT = stage.worldTransform.clone();

const ZOOM = Math.abs(stage.scale?.x || 1) || 1;

const wLen = (px) => px / ZOOM;

const hPx = (frac) => wLen(frac * H);

const waitMs = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Number(ms) || 0));

const spawned = [];

function destroyObj(o) { try { if (o && !o._destroyed) { if (o.parent) o.parent.removeChild(o); o.destroy({ children: true }); } } catch (_) {} }

function cleanupAll() { for (const o of spawned.splice(0)) destroyObj(o); }

let doneFired = false;

function fireDone(res) { if (doneFired) return; doneFired = true; try { Hooks.callAll(ctx.params.doneHook, res || { ok: true }); } catch (_) {} }

const easeInCubic = (t) => t*t*t;

const easeOutCubic = (t) => 1 - Math.pow(1-t,3);

const easeInOutCubic = (t) => t < 0.5 ? 4*t*t*t : 1 - Math.pow(-2*t+2,3)/2;

function tween(fn, dur, ease) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

const t0 = performance.now();

const step = () => { const raw = dur>0?Math.min(1,(performance.now()-t0)/dur):1; try{fn(ease?ease(raw):raw,raw);}catch(_){} if(raw>=1){ticker.remove(step);resolve();} };

ticker.add(step);

});

}

function meshOf(tok) { return tok ? tok.mesh : null; }

function makeSprite(tok, faceSign) {

const m = meshOf(tok);

const sp = new PIXI.Sprite(m?.texture ?? PIXI.Texture.WHITE);

sp.anchor.set(0.5, 0.5);

sp.width = Math.abs(m?.width ?? (tok?.w ?? 100));

sp.height = Math.abs(m?.height ?? (tok?.h ?? 100));

sp.angle = m?.angle ?? 0;

const sx = Math.sign(m?.scale?.x ?? 1) || 1, sy = Math.sign(m?.scale?.y ?? 1) || 1;

sp.scale.x = Math.abs(sp.scale.x) * sx * (faceSign || 1);

sp.scale.y = Math.abs(sp.scale.y) * sy;

return sp;

}

function makeHider(tok) {

const m = meshOf(tok); let on=false,tR=true,mR=true;

const guard = () => { if (!tok) return; tok.renderable = false; if (m) m.renderable = false; };

return { start(){ if(!tok||on)return; on=true; tR=tok.renderable??true; mR=m?.renderable??true; ticker.add(guard); },

restore(){ if(!tok||!on)return; ticker.remove(guard); tok.renderable=tR; if(m)m.renderable=mR; try{tok.renderFlags.set({refreshVisibility:true,refreshMesh:true,refreshState:true});}catch(_){} on=false; } };

}

function dotTexture(hex) {

const s = 64; const cv = document.createElement("canvas"); cv.width = cv.height = s;

const g = cv.getContext("2d");

const col = "#" + (hex >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(6, "0").slice(-6);

const grd = g.createRadialGradient(s/2, s/2, 0, s/2, s/2, s/2);

grd.addColorStop(0, "#ffffff"); grd.addColorStop(0.4, col); grd.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");

g.fillStyle = grd; g.beginPath(); g.arc(s/2, s/2, s/2, 0, Math.PI*2); g.fill();

return PIXI.Texture.from(cv);

}

try {

const home = caster ? { x: caster.center.x, y: caster.center.y } : { x: WT.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(0.3*W,0.5*H)).x, y: WT.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(0.3*W,0.5*H)).y };

const tgtTok = targetTokens[0] || null;

const tgt = tgtTok ? { x: tgtTok.center.x, y: tgtTok.center.y } : { x: WT.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(0.7*W,0.5*H)).x, y: WT.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(0.7*W,0.5*H)).y };

const dx = tgt.x-home.x, dy = tgt.y-home.y;

const faceSign = (tgt.x < home.x) ? -1 : 1;

const apex = { x: home.x + dx*cfg.lungeFrac, y: home.y + dy*cfg.lungeFrac };

const dotTex = dotTexture(cfg.particleColor);

const casterHide = makeHider(caster); casterHide.start();

const clone = makeSprite(caster, faceSign);

clone.x = home.x; clone.y = home.y; clone.zIndex = 9000;

stage.addChild(clone); spawned.push(clone);

// fast dash with afterimage trail

let lastGhost = 0;

await tween((p, raw) => {

clone.x = home.x + (apex.x-home.x)*p; clone.y = home.y + (apex.y-home.y)*p;

const now = performance.now();

if (now - lastGhost > cfg.ghostEveryMs) {

lastGhost = now;

const gh = makeSprite(caster, faceSign);

gh.x = clone.x; gh.y = clone.y; gh.zIndex = 8990; gh.alpha = cfg.ghostAlpha; gh.tint = 0xFFD0A0;

stage.addChild(gh); spawned.push(gh);

tween((q) => { gh.alpha = cfg.ghostAlpha*(1-q); }, cfg.ghostFadeMs, easeOutCubic).then(()=>destroyObj(gh));

}

}, cfg.lungeMs, easeInCubic);

// SLAM

fireDone({ ok: true });

const tgtHide = makeHider(tgtTok); let tgtClone = null;

if (tgtTok) {

tgtHide.start();

tgtClone = makeSprite(tgtTok, 1);

tgtClone.x = tgt.x; tgtClone.y = tgt.y; tgtClone.zIndex = 8500;

stage.addChild(tgtClone); spawned.push(tgtClone);

}

const shakeAmp = hPx(cfg.shakePx);

const shake = tween((p)=>{ if(!tgtClone)return; const d=(1-p)*shakeAmp; tgtClone.x=tgt.x+(Math.random()*2-1)*d; tgtClone.y=tgt.y+(Math.random()*2-1)*d; }, cfg.shakeMs, null).then(()=>{ if(tgtClone){tgtClone.x=tgt.x;tgtClone.y=tgt.y;} });

const flash = new PIXI.Sprite(dotTex);

flash.anchor.set(0.5); flash.zIndex = 9080; flash.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD; flash.tint = cfg.flashColor;

flash.x = tgt.x; flash.y = tgt.y; const fs = hPx(cfg.flashSize); flash.width = flash.height = fs*0.3;

stage.addChild(flash); spawned.push(flash);

tween((p)=>{ flash.width=flash.height=fs*(0.3+0.7*p); flash.alpha=1-p; }, 260, easeOutCubic).then(()=>destroyObj(flash));

for (let i = 0; i < cfg.particleCount; i++) {

const sp = new PIXI.Sprite(dotTex);

sp.anchor.set(0.5); sp.zIndex = 9050; sp.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

const sz = hPx(cfg.particleSize)*(0.5+Math.random()); sp.width=sp.height=sz; sp.tint = cfg.particleColor;

sp.x = tgt.x; sp.y = tgt.y; stage.addChild(sp); spawned.push(sp);

const a = Math.random()*Math.PI*2, spd = hPx(cfg.particleSpread)*(0.4+Math.random());

const vx = Math.cos(a)*spd, vy = Math.sin(a)*spd;

tween((p)=>{ sp.x=tgt.x+vx*p; sp.y=tgt.y+vy*p+hPx(0.05)*p*p; sp.alpha=1-p; sp.scale.set(1-0.5*p); }, cfg.particleMs, easeOutCubic).then(()=>destroyObj(sp));

}

await waitMs(cfg.recoilHoldMs);

await shake;

if (tgtTok) tgtHide.restore();

// recoil home

clone.scale.x = Math.abs(clone.scale.x) * (Math.sign(clone.scale.x)||1) * ((home.x < apex.x) ? -1 : 1);

await tween((p)=>{ clone.x=apex.x+(home.x-apex.x)*p; clone.y=apex.y+(home.y-apex.y)*p; }, cfg.returnMs, easeInOutCubic);

destroyObj(clone);

casterHide.restore();

await waitMs(cfg.endPadMs);

cleanupAll();

} catch (err) {

console.error("[ONI][Pseudo][Pounce]", err);

fireDone({ ok: false, error: String(err && err.message || err) });

} finally {

cleanupAll();

}

`;

try {

emitLocal("oni:animationStart", { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null });

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, cfg: CFG },

meta: { source: "Pounce" },

});

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, "pseudo non-OK / timeout", result);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, "orchestration crashed", err);

} finally {

emitLocal("oni:animationEnd", { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now() });

}

})();

// =============================================================================

// T1 - DOM melee lunge (pure PIXI, no webm). Parametric via a CFG object.

// Caster lunges toward the target, N glowing slash streaks rake across it, the

// target sprite shakes, embers fly. doneHook fires at the impact apex.

// =============================================================================

(async () => {

const CFG = {"lungeFrac":0.55,"lungeMs":150,"returnMs":180,"slashLen":0.16,"slashWidth":5,"slashCount":3,"slashGap":0.03,"slashStagger":55,"slashTilt":0,"particleCount":12,"particleSize":0.02,"particleSpread":0.12,"particleMs":500,"shakePx":0.012,"shakeMs":260,"endPadMs":120,"totalTimeoutMs":8000,"name":"Bite","key":"hellhound_bite","slashColor":16760960,"particleColor":16737824};

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][Melee][" + CFG.name + "]";

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.gen.melee." + CFG.key;

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) { try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; } }

function resolveSource() {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

return out;

}

const sourceToken = resolveSource();

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

const doneHook = "oni.anim." + ANIM_KEY + "." + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

function onceHook(name, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(name, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(name, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

Hooks.on(name, h);

});

}

function emitLocal(name, data) { try { Hooks.callAll(name, data); } catch (_) {} }

const scriptSource = String.raw`

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targetTokens = ctx.targetTokens || [];

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg;

const stage = canvas.stage;

stage.sortableChildren = true;

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const W = canvas.app.renderer.screen.width;

const H = canvas.app.renderer.screen.height;

const WT = stage.worldTransform.clone();

const ZOOM = Math.abs(stage.scale?.x || 1) || 1;

const wLen = (px) => px / ZOOM;

const hPx = (frac) => wLen(frac * H);

const waitMs = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Number(ms) || 0));

const spawned = [];

function destroyObj(o) { try { if (o && !o._destroyed) { if (o.parent) o.parent.removeChild(o); o.destroy({ children: true }); } } catch (_) {} }

function cleanupAll() { for (const o of spawned.splice(0)) destroyObj(o); }

let doneFired = false;

function fireDone(res) { if (doneFired) return; doneFired = true; try { Hooks.callAll(ctx.params.doneHook, res || { ok: true }); } catch (_) {} }

const easeOutCubic = (t) => 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);

const easeInCubic = (t) => t * t * t;

const easeInOutCubic = (t) => t < 0.5 ? 4 * t * t * t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 3) / 2;

function tween(fn, dur, ease) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

const t0 = performance.now();

const step = () => {

const raw = dur > 0 ? Math.min(1, (performance.now() - t0) / dur) : 1;

try { fn(ease ? ease(raw) : raw, raw); } catch (_) {}

if (raw >= 1) { ticker.remove(step); resolve(); }

};

ticker.add(step);

});

}

// token sprite clone + hide/restore (works for any token)

function meshOf(tok) { return tok ? tok.mesh : null; }

function makeSprite(tok, faceSign) {

const m = meshOf(tok);

const sp = new PIXI.Sprite(m?.texture ?? PIXI.Texture.WHITE);

sp.anchor.set(0.5, 0.5);

sp.width = Math.abs(m?.width ?? (tok?.w ?? 100));

sp.height = Math.abs(m?.height ?? (tok?.h ?? 100));

sp.angle = m?.angle ?? 0;

const sx = Math.sign(m?.scale?.x ?? 1) || 1;

const sy = Math.sign(m?.scale?.y ?? 1) || 1;

sp.scale.x = Math.abs(sp.scale.x) * sx * (faceSign || 1);

sp.scale.y = Math.abs(sp.scale.y) * sy;

return sp;

}

function makeHider(tok) {

const m = meshOf(tok);

let on = false, tR = true, mR = true;

const guard = () => { if (!tok) return; tok.renderable = false; if (m) m.renderable = false; };

return {

start() { if (!tok || on) return; on = true; tR = tok.renderable ?? true; mR = m?.renderable ?? true; ticker.add(guard); },

restore() {

if (!tok || !on) return; ticker.remove(guard);

tok.renderable = tR; if (m) m.renderable = mR;

try { tok.renderFlags.set({ refreshVisibility: true, refreshMesh: true, refreshState: true }); } catch (_) {}

on = false;

},

};

}

// a radial-gradient soft dot texture for embers

function dotTexture(hex) {

const s = 64; const cv = document.createElement("canvas"); cv.width = cv.height = s;

const g = cv.getContext("2d");

const col = "#" + (hex >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(6, "0").slice(-6);

const grd = g.createRadialGradient(s/2, s/2, 0, s/2, s/2, s/2);

grd.addColorStop(0, col); grd.addColorStop(0.4, col); grd.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");

g.fillStyle = grd; g.beginPath(); g.arc(s/2, s/2, s/2, 0, Math.PI*2); g.fill();

return PIXI.Texture.from(cv);

}

try {

const home = caster ? { x: caster.center.x, y: caster.center.y } : { x: WT.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(0.3*W,0.5*H)).x, y: WT.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(0.3*W,0.5*H)).y };

const tgtTok = targetTokens[0] || null;

const tgt = tgtTok ? { x: tgtTok.center.x, y: tgtTok.center.y } : { x: WT.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(0.7*W,0.5*H)).x, y: WT.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(0.7*W,0.5*H)).y };

const dx = tgt.x - home.x, dy = tgt.y - home.y;

const faceSign = (tgt.x < home.x) ? -1 : 1;

const apex = { x: home.x + dx * cfg.lungeFrac, y: home.y + dy * cfg.lungeFrac };

// 1) lunge caster toward target

const casterHide = makeHider(caster);

casterHide.start();

const clone = makeSprite(caster, faceSign);

clone.x = home.x; clone.y = home.y; clone.zIndex = 9000;

stage.addChild(clone); spawned.push(clone);

await tween((p) => { clone.x = home.x + (apex.x-home.x)*p; clone.y = home.y + (apex.y-home.y)*p; }, cfg.lungeMs, easeInCubic);

// 2) IMPACT: slashes + shake + embers (fire done here)

const dotTex = dotTexture(cfg.particleColor);

const slashLen = hPx(cfg.slashLen);

const slashHalf = slashLen / 2;

const baseAng = Math.atan2(dy, dx) - Math.PI/2 + (cfg.slashTilt || 0);

// shake target via clone

const tgtHide = makeHider(tgtTok);

let tgtClone = null;

if (tgtTok) {

tgtHide.start();

tgtClone = makeSprite(tgtTok, 1);

tgtClone.x = tgt.x; tgtClone.y = tgt.y; tgtClone.zIndex = 8500;

stage.addChild(tgtClone); spawned.push(tgtClone);

}

const shakeAmp = hPx(cfg.shakePx);

const shake = tween((p) => {

if (!tgtClone) return;

const d = (1 - p) * shakeAmp;

tgtClone.x = tgt.x + (Math.random()*2-1) * d;

tgtClone.y = tgt.y + (Math.random()*2-1) * d;

}, cfg.shakeMs, null).then(() => { if (tgtClone) { tgtClone.x = tgt.x; tgtClone.y = tgt.y; } });

fireDone({ ok: true });

// slash streaks

for (let i = 0; i < cfg.slashCount; i++) {

const off = (i - (cfg.slashCount-1)/2) * hPx(cfg.slashGap);

const perpX = Math.cos(baseAng + Math.PI/2), perpY = Math.sin(baseAng + Math.PI/2);

const cx = tgt.x + perpX * off, cy = tgt.y + perpY * off;

const g = new PIXI.Graphics();

g.zIndex = 9100; g.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

const ax = Math.cos(baseAng), ay = Math.sin(baseAng);

g.lineStyle(wLen(cfg.slashWidth), cfg.slashColor, 1);

g.moveTo(cx - ax*slashHalf, cy - ay*slashHalf);

g.lineTo(cx + ax*slashHalf, cy + ay*slashHalf);

g.x = 0; g.y = 0; g.alpha = 0;

stage.addChild(g); spawned.push(g);

(async () => {

await waitMs(i * cfg.slashStagger);

await tween((p) => { g.alpha = p; }, 70, easeOutCubic);

await tween((p) => { g.alpha = 1 - p; }, 220, easeInCubic);

destroyObj(g);

})();

}

// embers

for (let i = 0; i < cfg.particleCount; i++) {

const sp = new PIXI.Sprite(dotTex);

sp.anchor.set(0.5); sp.zIndex = 9050; sp.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

const sz = hPx(cfg.particleSize) * (0.6 + Math.random()*0.8);

sp.width = sp.height = sz;

sp.x = tgt.x; sp.y = tgt.y; sp.tint = cfg.particleColor;

stage.addChild(sp); spawned.push(sp);

const ang = Math.random()*Math.PI*2, spd = hPx(cfg.particleSpread) * (0.4 + Math.random());

const vx = Math.cos(ang)*spd, vy = Math.sin(ang)*spd - hPx(0.02);

(async () => {

await tween((p) => { sp.x = tgt.x + vx*p; sp.y = tgt.y + vy*p + hPx(0.05)*p*p; sp.alpha = 1 - p; sp.scale.set((1-0.5*p)); }, cfg.particleMs, easeOutCubic);

destroyObj(sp);

})();

}

await shake;

if (tgtTok) tgtHide.restore();

// 3) return caster home

clone.scale.x = Math.abs(clone.scale.x) * (Math.sign(clone.scale.x) || 1) * ((home.x < apex.x) ? -1 : 1);

await tween((p) => { clone.x = apex.x + (home.x-apex.x)*p; clone.y = apex.y + (home.y-apex.y)*p; }, cfg.returnMs, easeInOutCubic);

destroyObj(clone);

casterHide.restore();

await waitMs(cfg.endPadMs);

cleanupAll();

} catch (err) {

console.error("[ONI][Pseudo][Melee]", err);

fireDone({ ok: false, error: String(err && err.message || err) });

} finally {

cleanupAll();

}

`;

try {

emitLocal("oni:animationStart", { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null });

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs || 8000);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, cfg: CFG },

meta: { source: CFG.name },

});

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, "pseudo non-OK / timeout", result);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, "orchestration crashed", err);

} finally {

emitLocal("oni:animationEnd", { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now() });

}

})();

props.animation_script:
// =============================================================================

// Flamethrower (generic) - AoE fire cone-breath webm, reused across monsters.

// Ported verbatim from Wandering Flame's Flamethrower. Caster dashes to mid-scene,

// breathes a JB2A fire cone rotated toward the target centroid; doneHook fires

// when the webm ends so BD applies damage on the flame; webm finishes as tail.

// =============================================================================

(async () => {

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][Flamethrower]";

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.gen.flamethrower";

const CONE_URL = "modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Template/Cone/Breath_Weapon/BreathWeapon_Fire01_Regular_Orange_30ft_Cone_Burst_600x600.webm";

const CFG = {

midX: 0.5,

midY: 0.5,

dashMs: 380,

dashBackMs: 320,

anchorX: 0.02,

reach: 1.15,

minLen: 0.30,

maxLen: 0.95,

maxMs: 9000,

fadeMs: 260,

endPadMs: 120,

totalTimeoutMs: 12000,

sfxBreath: "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Fire1.ogg",

sfxBreathVol: 0.6,

};

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) {

try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; }

}

function resolveSource() {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) {

const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t;

}

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS))

for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

return out;

}

const sourceToken = resolveSource();

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

const doneHook = "oni.anim." + ANIM_KEY + "." + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

function onceHook(name, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(name, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(name, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

Hooks.on(name, h);

});

}

function emitLocal(name, data) { try { Hooks.callAll(name, data); } catch (_) {} }

const scriptSource = String.raw`

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targetTokens = ctx.targetTokens || [];

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg;

const A = ctx.params.assets;

const stage = canvas.stage;

stage.sortableChildren = true;

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const W = canvas.app.renderer.screen.width;

const H = canvas.app.renderer.screen.height;

const WT = stage.worldTransform.clone();

const ZOOM = Math.abs(stage.scale?.x || 1) || 1;

const S2W = (fx, fy) => WT.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(fx * W, fy * H));

const wLen = (px) => px / ZOOM;

const hPx = (frac) => wLen(frac * H);

const waitMs = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Number(ms) || 0));

const spawned = [];

function destroyObj(o) { try { if (o && !o._destroyed) { if (o.parent) o.parent.removeChild(o); o.destroy({ children: true }); } } catch (_) {} }

function cleanupAll() { for (const o of spawned.splice(0)) destroyObj(o); }

let doneFired = false;

function fireDone(res) { if (doneFired) return; doneFired = true; try { Hooks.callAll(ctx.params.doneHook, res || { ok: true }); } catch (_) {} }

const easeOutCubic = (t) => 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);

const easeInOutCubic = (t) => t < 0.5 ? 4 * t * t * t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 3) / 2;

function tween(fn, dur, ease) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

const t0 = performance.now();

const step = () => {

const raw = dur > 0 ? Math.min(1, (performance.now() - t0) / dur) : 1;

try { fn(ease ? ease(raw) : raw, raw); } catch (_) {}

if (raw >= 1) { ticker.remove(step); resolve(); }

};

ticker.add(step);

});

}

const baseMesh = caster ? caster.mesh : null;

const baseSignX = Math.sign(baseMesh?.scale?.x ?? 1) || 1;

const baseSignY = Math.sign(baseMesh?.scale?.y ?? 1) || 1;

function makeCasterSprite(faceSign) {

const sp = new PIXI.Sprite(baseMesh?.texture ?? PIXI.Texture.WHITE);

sp.anchor.set(0.5, 0.5);

sp.width = Math.abs(baseMesh?.width ?? (caster?.w ?? 100));

sp.height = Math.abs(baseMesh?.height ?? (caster?.h ?? 100));

sp.angle = baseMesh?.angle ?? 0;

sp.scale.x = Math.abs(sp.scale.x) * baseSignX * (faceSign || 1);

sp.scale.y = Math.abs(sp.scale.y) * baseSignY;

return sp;

}

let hiding = false, origTokR = true, origMeshR = true;

function hideGuard() { if (!caster) return; caster.renderable = false; if (baseMesh) baseMesh.renderable = false; }

function startHide() {

if (!caster || hiding) return;

hiding = true; origTokR = caster.renderable ?? true; origMeshR = baseMesh?.renderable ?? true;

ticker.add(hideGuard);

}

function restoreCaster() {

if (!caster || !hiding) return;

ticker.remove(hideGuard);

caster.renderable = origTokR; if (baseMesh) baseMesh.renderable = origMeshR;

try { caster.renderFlags.set({ refreshVisibility: true, refreshMesh: true, refreshState: true }); } catch (_) {}

hiding = false;

}

function centroid(toks, fx, fy) {

if (toks && toks.length) {

let sx = 0, sy = 0;

for (const t of toks) { sx += t.center.x; sy += t.center.y; }

return { x: sx / toks.length, y: sy / toks.length };

}

const q = S2W(fx, fy); return { x: q.x, y: q.y };

}

async function loadVideo(url) {

const vid = document.createElement("video");

try { vid.crossOrigin = "anonymous"; } catch (_) {}

vid.src = url; vid.muted = true; vid.loop = false; vid.playsInline = true; vid.preload = "auto";

await new Promise((res) => {

let done = false; const go = () => { if (done) return; done = true; res(); };

vid.addEventListener("loadeddata", go, { once: true });

vid.addEventListener("error", go, { once: true });

setTimeout(go, 1500);

});

return vid;

}

function playSfx(url, vol) {

if (!url) return;

try { const a = new Audio(url); a.volume = (vol == null ? 0.6 : vol); a.play().catch(() => {}); } catch (_) {}

}

try {

const home = caster ? { x: caster.center.x, y: caster.center.y } : (function () { const q = S2W(0.3, 0.5); return { x: q.x, y: q.y }; })();

const midP = S2W(cfg.midX, cfg.midY);

const mid = { x: midP.x, y: midP.y };

const end = centroid(targetTokens, 0.7, 0.5);

startHide();

const clone = makeCasterSprite((mid.x < home.x) ? -1 : 1);

clone.x = home.x; clone.y = home.y; clone.zIndex = 9000;

stage.addChild(clone); spawned.push(clone);

await tween((p) => { clone.x = home.x + (mid.x - home.x) * p; clone.y = home.y + (mid.y - home.y) * p; }, cfg.dashMs, easeInOutCubic);

clone.x = mid.x; clone.y = mid.y;

clone.scale.x = Math.abs(clone.scale.x) * baseSignX * ((end.x < mid.x) ? -1 : 1);

const ang = Math.atan2(end.y - mid.y, end.x - mid.x);

const dist = Math.hypot(end.x - mid.x, end.y - mid.y);

const desiredLen = Math.max(hPx(cfg.minLen), Math.min(hPx(cfg.maxLen), dist * cfg.reach));

const vid = await loadVideo(A.cone);

const tex = PIXI.Texture.from(vid);

const nativeW = tex.width || tex.orig?.width || 600;

const spr = new PIXI.Sprite(tex);

spr.anchor.set(cfg.anchorX, 0.5);

spr.x = mid.x; spr.y = mid.y;

spr.rotation = ang;

spr.scale.set(desiredLen / nativeW);

spr.zIndex = 8999;

stage.addChild(spr); spawned.push(spr);

try { vid.currentTime = 0; await vid.play(); } catch (_) {}

playSfx(cfg.sfxBreath, cfg.sfxBreathVol); // fire whoosh as the cone breathes

await new Promise((res) => {

let done = false; const go = () => { if (done) return; done = true; res(); };

vid.addEventListener("ended", go, { once: true });

setTimeout(go, cfg.maxMs);

});

fireDone({ ok: true });

await tween((p) => { spr.alpha = 1 - p; }, cfg.fadeMs, easeOutCubic);

destroyObj(spr);

try { vid.pause(); vid.removeAttribute("src"); vid.load(); } catch (_) {}

clone.scale.x = Math.abs(clone.scale.x) * baseSignX * ((home.x < mid.x) ? -1 : 1);

await tween((p) => { clone.x = mid.x + (home.x - mid.x) * p; clone.y = mid.y + (home.y - mid.y) * p; }, cfg.dashBackMs, easeInOutCubic);

destroyObj(clone);

restoreCaster();

await waitMs(cfg.endPadMs);

cleanupAll();

} catch (err) {

console.error("[ONI][Pseudo][Flamethrower]", err);

fireDone({ ok: false, error: String(err && err.message || err) });

} finally {

restoreCaster();

cleanupAll();

}

`;

try {

emitLocal("oni:animationStart", { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null });

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, cfg: CFG, assets: { cone: CONE_URL } },

meta: { source: "Flamethrower" },

});

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, "pseudo non-OK / timeout", result);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, "orchestration crashed", err);

} finally {

emitLocal("oni:animationEnd", { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now() });

}

})();
